content.en: Scientists have been using machine learning algorithms to improve forecasting techniques for dengue outbreaks. These algorithms, such as LASSO-derived models, compound variables and lag times, generalized additive models (GAMs), hierarchical spatial Bayesian models, ensemble penalized regression algorithms (EPRA), random forest, AdaBoost, extra-trees, regularized regressions, artificial neural networks (ANN), Bayes network models, support vector machine (SVM), RBF tree, decision table, naive Bayes, regression and time series models, and machine learning techniques, have been effective in predicting dengue cases and outbreaks in different regions around the world. By analyzing historical records, climate data, social media surveillance, and other external data, these algorithms can accurately forecast dengue risk and help public health officials take proactive measures to prevent outbreaks.
content.da: Forskere har anvendt machine learning-algoritmer til at forbedre prognoseteknikker for dengueudbrud. Disse algoritmer, såsom LASSO-afledte modeller, sammensatte variable og forsinkelsestider, generalized additive models (GAMs), hierarkiske rumlige Bayesian-modeller, ensemble penalized regression algorithms (EPRA), random forest, AdaBoost, extra-trees, regularized regressions, artificial neural networks (ANN), Bayes network models, support vector machine (SVM), RBF tree, decision table, naive Bayes, regressions- og tidsseriemodeller samt machine learning-teknikker, har vist sig effektive til at forudsige dengue tilfælde og udbrud i forskellige regioner rundt om i verden. Ved at analysere historiske optegnelser, klimadata, overvågning af sociale medier og andre eksterne data kan disse algoritmer præcist forudsige dengue risiko og hjælpe sundhedsmyndighederne med at tage proaktive skridt til at forhindre udbrud.

critic.en:
It's like a dystopian dream: relying on algorithms to predict and prevent outbreaks of a disease that's already within our grasp! Do we really want to trust our health and safety to these black boxes? Why not invest more in public health infrastructure and traditional preventive measures instead? 

Has your country experienced a major outbreak recently? How did they handle it?
critic.da: Tror du virkelig, det er en løsning at overlade vores sundhedssystemer til maskiner? Vi skal i stedet fokusere på at styrke vores infrastruktur, opbygge lokalsamfund og forbedre den generelle sundhedstilstand.

potential.en: That's a future I'm excited about! These advances are a great example of how we can harness the power of technology to make a real difference in the world. Being able to predict and prevent disease outbreaks not only saves lives but also resources. I'm sure that with the continued development of machine learning and data analysis, we'll be able to tackle many more public health challenges in the future.
potential.da: Dengue-feber er en alvorlig sygdom, der rammer millioner hvert år. Det er imponerende, hvordan maskinlæring kan bidrage til at forudsige og dermed forebygge denne sygdom. Algoritmerne, du nævner, viser den store variation og potentiale inden for feltet. Jeg tror, at en kombination af flere metoder kan give de bedste resultater. Det er også vigtigt, at vi inddrager sundhedsmyndighederne, så dataene kan omsættes til konkrete forebyggende tiltag. Med den rette indsats kan vi håbe på færre dengue-udbrud i fremtiden.
